import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}account-codes`;// Get Account Codes
const getAccountCodes=async(params,access_token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,{params:{...params}},config);return response.data;};// Get Bank Account Codes
const getBankAccountCodes=async access_token=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.get(`${base_url}bank-account-codes`,config);return response.data;};// Delete Account Code
const deleteAccountCode=async(id,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+id,config);return response.data;};// Update Account Code
const updateAccountCode=async(id,data,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+id,data,config);return response.data;};// Create new Account Code
const createAccountCode=async(data,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,data,config);return response.data;};const accountCodeService={getAccountCodes,createAccountCode,deleteAccountCode,updateAccountCode,getBankAccountCodes};export default accountCodeService;
